content: The ANLI benchmark presents a new challenge to the community. It was carefully constructed to mitigate issues with previous datasets, and was designed from first principles to last longer—if the test set saturates, the field can simply train up a new model, collect more data and find itself confronted yet again with a difficult challenge.
